vocab_words.example: The company went from near bankruptcy to a high level of profitability
Please review the agenda before tomorrow's meeting.
All correspondence with clients must be archived.
The manager sent a memorandum about the new dress code.
We need to order more stationery for the office.
The filing system was reorganized last month.
Her itinerary includes three cities in five days.
The board decided to postpone the annual meeting.
Each attendee received a printed handout.

items.question: The manager praised the team for their ___ to the project.
items.explanation: Cần danh từ sau tính từ sở hữu "their".

items.question: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the schedule change.
items.explanation: Với cấu trúc "neither...nor", động từ chia theo chủ ngữ gần nhất (employees - số nhiều).

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: All visitors must sign in ___ entering the building.
items.explanation: Ngữ nghĩa yêu cầu ký tên trước khi vào tòa nhà nên dùng "before".

items.question: ___ the budget cuts, the department managed to complete the project on time.
items.explanation: "Despite" theo sau là cụm danh từ (the budget cuts), không phải mệnh đề đầy đủ.

items.question: The training session was ___ informative that attendees asked for a follow-up.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "so + adj + that" diễn tả kết quả.

items.question: ___ the delay, the project was completed under budget.
items.explanation: "Despite" + cụm danh từ, không phải mệnh đề đầy đủ như "although".

items.question: All applicants must have ___ experience in customer service.
items.explanation: Cần tính từ (adjective) đứng trước danh từ "experience".

items.question: The factory has implemented new procedures to ___ workplace accidents.
items.explanation: Sau "to" (mục đích) cần động từ nguyên mẫu.

items.question: The committee is reviewing several proposals ___ improving workplace safety.
items.explanation: Cụm "proposals for + V-ing" nghĩa là đề xuất nhằm mục đích gì.
